title: 目標達成の後に・落星

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown is over with Meisho Doto successfully fulfilling all her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But we're soon met with bad news. Admire Vega must abstain from running due to inflammation in her legs. Worse, there's no telling when she'll be able to return.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O laments the situation, suggesting that the only available option is to wait. The ever-timid Doto, however, has another idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something awakens in her, and she resolves to be stronger so that she can accompany Opera O through the year's G1 races. Goal in mind, Doto decides to try a G2—January's Nikkei Shinshun Hai.
